METHODOLOGY/FIVE DISCIPLINED STAGES

HOW THE WORK GOES

Every website project follows a transparent five-stage progression from initial requirements to final deployment and handoff. Clear milestones, continuous visibility, and zero guesswork.

01ALIGNMENT

Discovery

Understand the business, target audience, objectives, and requirements.

EXECUTION:

We clarify the target audience, brand positioning, core inquiry goals, and technical scope before touching code.

02SPECIFICATION

Scope & Proposal

Define the deliverables, required features, timeline, and quotation.

EXECUTION:

We agree on the information architecture, section blueprints, required integrations, and a transparent quotation with delivery milestones.

03ENGINEERING

Design & Development

Implement the agreed design and functionality with clean code.

EXECUTION:

Writing semantic HTML, fluid responsive CSS, and accessible React components with smooth interactions and zero template bloat.

04VERIFICATION

Quality Assurance

Test responsive layouts, navigation, forms, integrations, and relevant functionality.

EXECUTION:

Comprehensive viewport testing across smartphones, tablets, and desktops, form validation checks, Core Web Vitals audit, and cross-browser verification.

05DELIVERY

Launch & Handover

Deploy the approved website and hand over the agreed project assets.

EXECUTION:

Production hosting deployment, domain DNS setup, final live sanity verification, and clean repository or documentation handoff.

REALISTIC DELIVERY SCHEDULES:

Standard business websites and landing page builds typically launch within 1 to 3 weeks. Turnaround depends on scope complexity, content readiness, and feedback cycles.

POST-LAUNCH & MAINTENANCE:

All agreed project assets and documentation are handed over at launch. Ongoing technical maintenance, regular content updates, and future enhancements can be discussed separately.

Precision in craft. Partnership in practice.

I'm Charles Naveen, a freelance web developer with a B.Sc. in Computer Science based in Tamil Nadu, India. I design and build modern, responsive websites for businesses and partner with digital marketing agencies that need reliable development support.

My focus is practical: presenting your business with authority, loading fast on every device, and making it effortless for prospective clients to contact you. I build from scratch using React, modern CSS, and clean web standards instead of fragile pre-made templates.

When you work with me, you work directly with an independent developer who takes personal ownership of your code, communicates transparently, and respects project timelines.
